subjectHint: CC Partial Refund Error for OrderID: @Order.OrderID@
body:
Hello,
There was an attempt to refund a credit card transaction but it appears to have failed. The details are listed below:

Customer: @Customer.Name@ (@Customer.CustomerID@)
OrderID: @Order.OrderID@

CRM Actual Refund: $@Order.OriginalRefundAmount@
Actual Base Commerce Refund: $@Order.ActualRefundAmount@

Please contact the IT department if you have any questions.
